blocks.text: The first big holiday is Lunar New Year’s, which is also known as Seollal.
It is celebrated on the first day of the first month on the lunar calendar.
The most important Lunar New Year’s custom is the ancestral memorial rites ceremony.
Each member of the family gets up early in the morning and dresses in their best clothes.
During this ceremony, Koreans perform a ritual ceremony in honor of their ancestors.
Following the ceremony, the youth bow to their elders as a gesture of wishing everyone many new blessings during the upcoming new year.
To bow on the Lunar New Year is a special honor and privilege of showing respect to one’s elders.
